name: Caucasian rhododendron
desc: A low evergreen shrub of the high Caucasus, known as the Georgian snow rose. Its alpine scrub is the open-slope habitat the Caucasian grouse favours.
about: Rhododendron caucasicum, the Caucasian rhododendron or the Georgian snow rose, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Rhododendron native to the Transcaucasus and Anatolia.
